verdict.rationale: An identity platform could plausibly offer AI-generated insights inside the product, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no AI-driven insights or suggestions in Entra ID. The 'data insights' mentioned refer to routing activity logs to external endpoints and to Graph API data access, which are adjacent, non-AI features. The MCP probe concerns Microsoft Learn documentation, not in-product AI insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
